column1: # Mass checkpoint independently solved in GHA run 31929886661.  That run
# rejected its curvature stencil after the root itself met closure, event, and
# stationarity gates.  The original Float64 chart remains only a correction seed.
# WARM START (2026-08-16).  The masses below are the Newton iterate 2 emitted by
# julia/verify_secondary_minus_fold.jl itself in GHA run 31932398513, job
# bigfloat-fold (log line "fold iter=2"), where the fold root met every frozen
# target with margin:
# That job was then SIGKILLed by its 120-minute job wall ~33 s later, before
# audit_fold and the two branch solves ever ran, so no artifact was written.
# Seeding from the solver's own converged iterate is a warm start only: the
# verifier re-corrects the orbit from scratch and must still satisfy every gate
# (closure, event, stationarity, stencil convergence, transversality, branch
# straddle and curvature agreement) independently.  It removes one ~92-minute
# Newton step, not a single check.  The previous seed differed from this one at
# the 13th significant digit and failed |G-| <= 1e-12 by a factor of 1.6.
